description: Test harness code for browser server control, including mocks, environment setup, and test lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: getBrowserControlServerTestState
methods.description: Returns the current test harness state object.

methods.name: getBrowserControlServerBaseUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the base URL for the browser control server.

methods.name: restoreGatewayPortEnv
methods.description: Restores the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_PORT environment variable to its previous value.

methods.name: setBrowserControlServerCreateTargetId
methods.description: Sets the createTargetId in the test harness state.

methods.name: setBrowserControlServerAttachOnly
methods.description: Sets the attachOnly configuration in the test harness state.

methods.name: setBrowserControlServerEvaluateEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables evaluate feature in the test harness state.

methods.name: setBrowserControlServerReachable
methods.description: Sets the reachable status in the test harness state.

methods.name: setBrowserControlServerProfiles
methods.description: Updates the profiles and default profile in the test harness state.

methods.name: getCdpMocks
methods.description: Returns the mock functions related to CDP interactions.

methods.name: getPwMocks
methods.description: Returns the mock functions related to Playwright interactions.

methods.name: getChromeMcpMocks
methods.description: Returns the mock functions related to Chrome MCP interactions.

methods.name: getLaunchCalls
methods.description: Returns the array of launch call records.

methods.name: startBrowserControlServerFromConfig
methods.description: Starts the browser control server using the loaded configuration.

methods.name: stopBrowserControlServer
methods.description: Stops the browser control server if running.

methods.name: makeResponse
methods.description: Creates a mock Response object with specified body and status.

methods.name: resetBrowserControlServerTestContext
methods.description: Resets the test context to initial state, including environment variables and mocks.

methods.name: restoreGatewayAuthEnv
methods.description: Restores the gateway token and password environment variables to previous values.

methods.name: cleanupBrowserControlServerTestContext
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, restoring environment and stopping server.

methods.name: installBrowserControlServerHooks
methods.description: Sets up hooks for test lifecycle, including mocks and fetch interception.
